cases.question: How many days do customers have to return a product after delivery?
cases.answer: Customers may return standard products within 30 days of delivery. A Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number is required before any return is shipped. Defects must be reported within 7 days of delivery with photos. (Source: Returns and Refund Policy)

cases.question: What is the restocking fee for non-defective returns?
cases.answer: Non-defective returns of standard items are charged a 15% restocking fee. The fee is waived for defective or incorrectly shipped items. Customers may return standard products within 30 days of delivery. (Source: Returns and Refund Policy)

cases.question: What is the cutoff time for same-day shipping?
cases.answer: Orders placed before 2 PM Eastern Time ship the same business day. International shipping is not supported. Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and costs a flat $25. (Source: Shipping and Delivery Policy)

cases.question: How much does express shipping cost?
cases.answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and costs a flat $25. Standard shipping is free on orders where goods total $500 or more after discounts. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs a flat $60. (Source: Shipping and Delivery Policy)

cases.question: What are the payment terms for approved accounts?
cases.answer: Approved accounts have Net 30 payment terms. Customers who pay within 10 days receive a 2% early payment discount (2/10 net 30). Orders are placed on hold when an account is more than 15 days past due. (Source: Credit and Payment Terms)

cases.question: What late fee do you charge on overdue invoices?
cases.answer: Late invoices incur a late fee of 1.5% per month. (Source: Credit and Payment Terms)

cases.question: How long is the warranty on tools?
cases.answer: Tools carry a 2 year warranty. Safety gear carries a 1 year warranty. Torque wrenches must have their calibration certificate renewed annually to keep the warranty valid. (Source: Warranty Policy)

cases.question: Who needs to approve a purchase order above $5,000?
cases.answer: Purchase orders over $5,000 require director approval. Purchase orders move from Draft to Manager approval to Sent. Orders with a pre-discount subtotal of $2,000 or more receive an additional 2% volume discount. (Source: Inventory Replenishment SOP, Pricing and Discounts)

cases.question: How quickly must a chemical spill be reported?
cases.answer: Any spill must be reported to the safety officer within 1 hour. Chemical products must be stored in flammables cabinets at both warehouses. Every chemical SKU must have a current Safety Data Sheet (SDS) on file. (Source: Hazardous Materials Handling)

cases.question: When is customer support closed for Thanksgiving?
cases.answer: We are closed on Thanksgiving (November 26, 2026), December 25 and January 1. Customer support is available Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM Eastern Time. Gold tier customers receive 5% off list price. (Source: Support Hours and Holidays, Pricing and Discounts)

cases.question: How do I get reimbursed for faulty goods?
cases.answer: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the returned goods are received and inspected. (Source: Returns and Refund Policy)

cases.question: What temperature must Parmigiano be stored at?
cases.answer: Perishable goods such as Parmigiano Reggiano must be stored at 2 to 4 degrees Celsius and shipped in insulated packaging. (Source: Cold Chain Handling SOP)

cases.question: How often are API keys rotated?
cases.answer: API keys are rotated every 90 days. (Source: Data Privacy and Security Policy)

cases.question: How long are order records retained?
cases.answer: Order records are retained for 7 years. Changes to confirmed orders require manager approval. Orders on hold are automatically cancelled after 14 days. (Source: Data Privacy and Security Policy, Order Cancellation and Changes)

cases.question: Does Helix ship internationally?
cases.answer: Orders placed before 2 PM Eastern Time ship the same business day. International shipping is not supported. They ship by ground only and cannot be sent express. (Source: Shipping and Delivery Policy)

cases.question: What does the pricing policy say about tier discounts for gold customers?
cases.answer: Gold tier customers receive 5% off list price. Platinum tier customers receive 10% off list price. Gold tier customers have a $25,000 limit and platinum tier customers have a $50,000 limit. (Source: Pricing and Discounts, Credit and Payment Terms)
